fields.mechanism: Low-grade water-source heat pump within a multi-grade thermal integration architecture lifts rejected low-grade heat to a useful thermal grade for downstream loads
fields.intervention: Install a compact water-source heat pump (sized within the 4.2 x 2.8 m plant room footprint) evaporator-coupled to the chiller condenser loop at 32 C, using an R-1234ze/R-513A-class low-GWP refrigerant, discharging to a plate heat exchanger that preheats boiler feedwater, with staged condenser-loop diversion so heat is routed to preheating before tower rejection
fields.expected_effect: Recovered 32 C condenser rejection is upgraded to 55-70 C feedwater preheat, cutting annual steam purchases for laundry/sterilization feedwater heating

fields.mechanism: Multi-grade thermal integration — coordinating high- and low-grade heat streams so each recovered stream is dispatched to a thermal load matched to its own temperature grade, yielding primary energy savings versus single-grade rejection.
